notes.title: Update Version 0.048
notes.content:
New Update Version 0.048 - 10.09.24 Steam
Previous Update: Version 0.047 - 09.07.24

@everyone The latest update is now live, featuring the following changes:

Vehicles
Added:
Stunt Scooter
Dirtbike
Motocross
Autocrane
Prototype Vehicle
Removed:
Motorcycle
Sportsbike
Scooter
Maps
New:
Downhill Ramps
Simple Ramps
Removed:
Infinite Rooms
Mechanics
Updated motor physics for select vehicles
Stabilized physics for scooters and BMX bikes
Added 3D modeling capabilities with "Custom-Mesh" in Building/Tools
Tools
New Tools:
Rail-Gun
Weight-Gun
Additional Tool Changes:
Freeze Modes
Tool-Gun resized (now smaller)
Increased lever friction
Scripting
Added Nodes:
Player Position Node
Transform Node
Teleport Node
Fixed Rigidbody Node issues
Bug Fixes
Resolved issue where the menu would break when the spawn-gun was holstered
